schemaMatches.quantity: card-space normal XY (encoded unorm) and a validity flag; Z is reconstructed
schemaMatches.coordinateSpace: card space (capture view axes are the card OBB axes; the shader writes view-space normal)

transforms.name: decodeNormal
transforms.expression: N.xy = code.xy*2-1; N.z = sqrt(max(1 - |N.xy|^2, 1e-4)); WorldNormal = normalize(mul(Card.WorldToLocalRotation, N))

mathTerms: 2-channel 8-bit encoding; z reconstructed with a 1e-4 clamp
the capture view is card-axis aligned, so the view-space normal written by LumenCardBasePass equals card space
gaps: Sign of Z is always positive; back-facing cards are represented by mirrored card UV / card axes, not by a negative Z.
Validity is the alpha of this target, not the depth target.

fields.name: bValid
fields.decode: written as 1 for captured texels; the surface-cache copy tests this alpha > 0.5 to decide validity
